description: List the user's folders (decks): id, name, emoji, language (`lang`), the language of the translations (`native_lang`), card count, and which one is the default for new words. Its ids are the `folder_id` values the folder tools, move_card and capture_word take. Pass `lang` to see only folders of one learning language. Folders the user hid from Claude are not listed.

lang.description: Optional ISO code: only folders for this learning language.

name: list_folders
title: List folders
